name: Bone paper
note: Warm bone base with fine paper grain. The calmest step away from pure white.

name: Blueprint hairline grid
note: Pale sage with an engineer's hairline grid (60 px minor, 300 px major). Says plots, survey, plan.

name: Sunburst echo
note: The badge's sunburst repeated as faint rays across the whole poster. Ties everything to the logo.

name: Contour land
note: Topographic contour lines: land, plots, terrain. Hand-drawn feel that templates rarely have.

name: Concrete
note: Cool concrete grey with coarse mottling plus fine grain. Industrial, honest, a little brutalist.

name: Warm halftone
note: Print-style halftone dots fading from the top right corner in warm amber. Poster-shop energy.

name: Deep green night
note: Brand green as the whole canvas, cream text. Boldest option; the photo sits as a clean window.

name: Sand gradient
note: Soft cream to sand gradient with a touch of grain. Quiet and premium.

name: Control: bone only
note: Same Montserrat and Inter as the final, only the bone colour. Shows what the background alone changes.

name: Duotone green
note: Same render turned into brand green and white. Looks printed, ties to the badge green.

name: Line sketch
note: Same render as fine charcoal linework. Plan and drawing feel, very distinctive.

name: Charcoal mono
note: Same render in greyscale. Lets the yellow badge and CTA carry the colour.

name: Original render
note: The supplied render, on bone paper. Baseline for the image tests.

name: Warm grade
note: Same render graded warm, like late afternoon light.

name: AI aerial layout
note: AI generated concept: isometric plot layout.

name: AI blueprint line
note: AI generated concept: architectural line drawing.

name: AI flat illustration
note: AI generated concept: flat vector style in brand colours.

name: AI golden hour
note: AI generated concept: warm golden hour version of the scene.

name: Blueprint room
note: Hairline grid, Barlow Semi Condensed and the AI line drawing. A survey sheet that happens to sell plots.

name: Blueprint night
note: Deep green canvas, the line drawing inverted to cream and screen blended in. Feels like a lit drawing board.

name: Sun and aerial
note: Sunburst rays, Poppins and the isometric plot layout. Bright and energetic, the layout is the star.

name: Land and layout
note: Contour lines under the isometric layout, Bricolage Grotesque. The land theme made literal.

name: Brutalist
note: Concrete grey, Space Grotesk and the charcoal photo. Colour comes only from the badge, CTA and flag.

name: Golden print
note: Warm halftone dots, Outfit and the golden hour render. Looks like a screen printed poster.

name: Quiet premium
note: Sand gradient, Red Hat Display and the warm graded photo. The most calm and expensive feeling.

name: Technical sketch
note: Grid, Barlow and the local line sketch of the real render. Technical without any AI image.

name: Sunshine yellow
note: A pale brand yellow canvas with darker rays, Poppins, original render. The badge colour carried across the whole sheet.

name: Split sage
note: Sage block over bone with a slanted join (echoing the flag), Archivo and the green duotone photo. Two zones, one calm palette.

name: Photo first
note: Hero image leads at the top, the badge sits on its lower edge, then name, proof, facilities, CTA. Emotion before facts.

name: Sandwich
note: Name, then the photo, then the proof grid. Photo moves up so the eye lands on the place before the numbers.

name: Left editorial
note: Badge and name aligned to one left edge, the rest stays on the full width grid. Strong single alignment axis.

name: Compact header
note: Badge beside the name saves height, so the image gets 760 px and the stats stay unchanged.

name: Footer band
note: Charcoal band behind facilities and CTA: the yellow CTA gets maximum contrast and the page gets a clear base.

name: Sun tiles on bone
note: Bone, tiny sunbursts repeated across the sheet, Archivo.

name: Plot plan sage
note: Sage with a site plan behind the content, Barlow, the isometric layout image.

name: Circuit night
note: Deep green with fine cream circuit traces, Plus Jakarta Sans.

name: Flag hatch on sand
note: Sand gradient with the flag colours as faint slanted hairlines, Red Hat Display.

name: Diamond chain cream
note: Cream with rows of the badge diamonds, Poppins.

name: Halo rings
note: Ripples from the badge across a warm base, Outfit and DM Sans.

name: Road lanes concrete
note: Concrete grey with road lanes and yellow dashes, Space Grotesk.

name: Mini suns on yellow
note: Pale brand yellow with small sunbursts, Poppins.
